cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable
D="/app/tmp/work/perf"; os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":7,"prefix_width":8,
     "rules":[{"id":i,"class":i%100,"priority":i%5,"ranges":[[1,2048],[1,2048]]} for i in range(50)],
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
open(D+"/r.cfg","w").write(json.dumps(cfg,separators=(',',':')))
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=open(D+"/r.cfg","rb").read(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
assert p.returncode==0
open(D+"/r.prog","wb").write(p.stdout)
rng=random.Random(5)
t=0
lines=[]
# 100000 requests: mostly small chunks + ticks + open/close churn
fid=0
open_ids=[]
for i in range(100000):
    r=rng.random()
    if r<0.10 or not open_ids:
        while fid in open_ids: fid+=1
        lines.append('{"op":"open","flow":%d,"time":%d}'%(fid,t)); open_ids.append(fid); fid+=1
    elif r<0.20:
        f=open_ids.pop(rng.randrange(len(open_ids)))
        lines.append('{"op":"close","flow":%d,"time":%d}'%(f,t))
    elif r<0.30:
        t+=rng.randrange(1,5)
        lines.append('{"op":"tick","time":%d}'%t)
    else:
        t+=1
        pk=[{"flow":rng.choice(open_ids),"time":t,"source":rng.randrange(2),"length":rng.randrange(1,2049)} for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,4))]
        lines.append('{"op":"chunk","packets":%s}'%json.dumps(pk,separators=(',',':')))
lines.append('{"op":"checkpoint"}')
open(D+"/r.req","w").write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
print("input MiB", os.path.getsize(D+"/r.req")/1048576)
t0=time.time()
with open(D+"/r.req","rb") as fi, open(D+"/r.out","wb") as fo:
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",D+"/r.prog"],stdin=fi,stdout=fo)
print("rc",p.returncode,"stream %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), "out MiB", os.path.getsize(D+"/r.out")/1048576)
EOF
